item.title: He died in a hot house. Why isn't it on his death record?
item.description: Arizona's heat death count excludes Adam Willson, illustrating how many such deaths may go unrecorded annually.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: U.S. strikes Iran for a second day, Trump addresses gas prices ahead of midterms, and Ed Markey wins in Massachusetts.

item.title: Israel denies entry to U.S. citizens over criticism and Palestinian ties, lawyers report
item.description: Travelers from the U.S. and other countries are being refused entry to Israel after questioning about their connections to Palestinians and planned visits to occupied areas.

item.title: Tariffs and midterms: A Michigan border town faces economic and political uncertainty
item.description: The U.S.-Canada trade dispute affects Michigan's economy and politics, as Canada is the state's largest trading partner.
